title: Structural rules travel; behavioural ones don't

rules.name: Undo
rules.definition: a hunk that returns a file to an earlier state (kept from the no-tools draft)

rules.name: Edit after a repeat
rules.definition: a file change within 3 operations after a repeated test result

rules.name: Repeated target
rules.definition: a repeated read, search, plan or build target

rules.name: Repeated error line
rules.definition: a failure whose error line was seen in the last 15 operations
